identity.name: Delray Trails
identity.notes: Gated 55+ active adult master-planned community in Delray Beach, FL 33484, developed by Lennar with approximately 436 villas, single-family homes, condos, and townhomes. Established in 2020 and managed by Lennar Homes LLC. Resort-style community with shared recreation amenities through association with Palm Greens Recreation Association. Located at 5832 Shining Sea Court. Currently sold out (as of latest source data).

fees.note: Single-family homes: $381–$412/month. Includes common area maintenance, grounds, building maintenance, roof, pool, security, insurance, water, electric, trash, sewer, pest control, internet, laundry, parking, recreation facilities. Condos: $360–$580/month. Townhomes: $358–$760/month. (Source data as of Oct 2026)
Estimates from real estate listings typically in the $300–$600 range monthly; exact figures and special assessments unavailable without direct HOA confirmation.

Official Lennar Community Fact Sheet, 2023 (dated 03/23): Single-family homesite base (abated) HOA fee. Includes utilities for common areas, landscape/irrigation maintenance, access control/entry, and association common area insurance. Homeowner pays own insurance. Subject to change without notice; verify with HOA for current year. 2023 figures may be outdated for 2025/2026 buyers.
Official Lennar Community Fact Sheet, 2023: Single-family homesite HOA fee WITH Recreation add-on (base $336.54 + ~$75.00 recreation).
Official Lennar Community Fact Sheet, 2023: Villas homesite base (abated) HOA fee.
Official Lennar Community Fact Sheet, 2023: Villas homesite HOA fee WITH Recreation add-on (base $282.90 + ~$75.00 recreation).
Official Lennar Community Fact Sheet, 2023: Recreation fee is ~$75.00/month per home (marked as estimate); excluded from abated fee.
Official Lennar Community Fact Sheet, 2023: Bulk Internet (1 GIG) - $43.99 per month per home.

BEX Realty listing-site range (lower bound recorded): HOA fees for Delray Trails homes (single-family) range $381-$412/month. Fee said to include common area maintenance, grounds, pool, security, property insurance, water, electric, trash, sewer, pest control, internet, laundry, parking, recreation.
BEX Realty listing-site range (lower bound recorded): Delray Trails condo HOA fees range $360-$580/month.
BEX Realty listing-site range (lower bound recorded): Delray Trails townhome HOA fees range $358-$760/month.
Active MLS listing (BeachesMLS, via Trulia) for 5824 Shining Sea Ct, Delray Trails townhome: HOA Fee $371/month; HOA fee includes common areas and grounds maintenance.
Horizon Palm Realty: community HOA fees averaging $388/month. Also reports annual property taxes averaging $1,113.
HOA Bulletin Board: monthly HOA fee 'approximately $250' - unverified estimate; conflicts with all other sources (which show $282-$760). Treat as unreliable.

Some associations require a one-time capital contribution or transfer fee at closing (master and/or neighborhood association), separate from monthly dues. Amount for Delray Trails not found in any source - confirm with written association package.

Palm Greens Recreation Association (which per its site comprises Condo 1, Condo II and Delray Trails) comprises main pool area, hot tub, 9 tennis courts, shuffleboard, bocci court and a clubhouse; newly built clubhouse houses offices, gym, card and billiard rooms, art classes, library and a theater. Clubs host many events throughout the year.
Housed in the Palm Greens clubhouse shared with Delray Trails residents; billiard room also independently listed in MLS-derived amenity data.
Gated master-planned community; official Lennar 2023 fact sheet lists 'Access Control/Entry' as included in the HOA fee. Page also notes community is currently sold out (no homes available).
BEX Realty: HOA rules allow pets with certain breed restrictions, a limit on the number of pets, and a restriction on pet size. Specific breeds/limits not published in sources found.

open_questions: Current (2025/2026) HOA dues: the only official schedule found is the Lennar fact sheet dated 03/2023 ($282.90-$411.54/mo by home type, +~$75 recreation). Listing sites show $358-$760/mo by product type and an MLS-specific $371/mo; the HOA Bulletin Board's ~$250/mo is unverified and conflicts with everything else. Confirm current amounts with Lennar/HOA (561-345-6700).
CDD special assessments: no Community Development District or special assessment information found for Delray Trails in any source. Confirm with HOA/title company.
One-time capital contribution / transfer fee at closing is mentioned as possible but no amount was found. Obtain the written association package.

Driving distances from the community (5832 Shining Sea Court, 33484) to Atlantic Avenue, Publix Delray Square, the library, and zoned schools could not be verified numerically - marketing sources only say 'moments away' / 'minutes from'. The 6.6-mi hospital distance is as listed for ZIP 33484/Delray Beach generally, not from the community gate.

School zoning (Banyan Creek Elementary / Carver Community Middle / Atlantic High) comes from MLS-derived listing data for one Delray Trails address; verify boundaries with Palm Beach County School District's map tool.

Community-level demographics are unavailable; only ZIP 33484 (median age 66.7, median HH income $62,151 per 2024 ACS via zip-codes.com; ~81% owner-occupied) and city of Delray Beach (Census QuickFacts ACS 2020-2024: population 69,809, median HH income $82,041, 63.2% owner-occupied, 28% age 65+) aggregates exist. The two sources conflict on income/occupancy - geography levels differ.
Pet policy specifics (which breeds are restricted, maximum number of pets, size limits) are not published in the sources found.

Palm Greens clubhouse amenities (gym, card/billiard rooms, theater, library, art classes) are shared via the Recreation Association - confirm Delray Trails resident access rights and any separate recreation-association dues beyond the ~$75/mo recreation fee.
